children: New ERA Energy & Digital announced two related agreements to advance its Texas Critical Data Center project near Odessa. The company signed a 20-year Power Purchase Agreement with Luminant for 200-207 MW, backed by a $116 million letter of credit and up to $82.8 million in additional security, subject to conditions by Dec. 31, 2027. Concurrently, it entered a Development Framework Agreement with Vistra, providing a five-year right of first offer on certain projects, a right of first refusal on onsite generation beginning April 2028, reimbursement mechanics for infrastructure, and a 5% non-voting equity stake for Vistra once power begins. Together, the deals secure long-term power and align future onsite generation and infrastructure for expansion.
